assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: portrait background illustration for a daily mobile beer sipping game, clean 2:3 portrait composition.
Style/medium: cohesive editorial travel postcard illustration, finely painted gouache and colored pencil with subtle paper grain, rich believable architecture and materials, natural depth, polished but understated, nostalgic holiday memory with friends. Not cartoon, not flat vector, not photorealism.
Composition/framing: point of view seated at a table. A broad clean tabletop in the lowest 30% of the image, with its rear edge approximately 70% down the image. Empty quiet central foreground reserved for a separately composited beer vessel, extending from about 25% down to 75% down; background architecture can be visible behind this area but do not put people or objects there. Scene details and friends gather around the outer edges and in the distance. Straight-on portrait view, realistic seated perspective. No featured drink, no foreground bottle or glass, no props in the central tabletop region.
Constraints: scenery only, no text, no lettering, no signage with writing, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no borders. People only small soft background figures, anonymous and naturally proportioned. Table occupies full width at bottom; no severe high contrast edges behind central vessel area.
Primary request: The memory of drinking a Guinness with friends in a welcoming old Irish pub.
Scene/backdrop: a centuries-old Irish pub interior, aged dark oak wall panels and ceiling beams, worn polished wooden bar at far left, a quietly glowing small fireplace toward right, mellow amber shaded lamps, small leaded windows catching the last dusk. A few very small friends chatting at distant side tables, coats hung at far edge, place dominates.
Lighting/mood: intimate soft amber evening light, warm highlights on old wood, deep muted green shadows, cozy and convivial rather than empty.
Color palette: forest green, dark oak brown, burnished amber, warm ivory. Foreground tabletop aged warm dark oak, broad, calm and uncluttered.

Primary request: The memory of sharing beers with friends at a beach palapa in Cabo San Lucas, Mexico.
Scene/backdrop: from the shade of a beach palapa looking over ivory white sand toward brilliant turquoise sea, recognizable distant ochre rocky Cabo headland and a small distant sea arch toward one far side. Loose palm fronds at top edges, palapa thatch edge casting gentle shade. A few very small friends relaxing at distant edge tables, shoreline walkers tiny.
Lighting/mood: hazy sunlit afternoon, airy breeze, carefree coastal warmth, pale sand reflected light beneath shade.
Color palette: turquoise sea, pale aqua, ivory sand, warm ochre rock, soft palm green. Foreground tabletop weathered honey-colored wood, broad clean planks and uncluttered.

Primary request: The memory of sharing steins with friends beneath the grand tent roof at Oktoberfest in Munich.
Scene/backdrop: an authentic spacious Munich Oktoberfest beer tent, cream canvas ceiling with visible curved timber roof ribs and blue-and-white Bavarian bunting, strings of small warm golden lamps and one subtly ornate hanging chandelier high in the distance. Wooden communal tables recede down side aisles; small distant friend silhouettes gather convivially at the sides, hints of Bavarian outfits without prominent people.
Lighting/mood: golden early evening inside the tent, cheerful warmth, sense of communal celebration and friendship, gentle background bustle.
Color palette: cream canvas, warm oak, Bavarian blue and white, soft golden lamp light. Foreground broad uncluttered wooden beer table with worn honey-oak planks.
